status: Text OK'd by the owner 2026-11-09 (docs/design/STORY_R1_SCRIPT_DRAFT.md). People use stand-in models; Brumlet waits for a model; Logwarden's model is not yet approved. Spots are for the test village.

lines.text: The boat from the mainland takes three days.
On the third morning the fog lifts over Lantern Quay.
People here say the islands used to hum.
There you are! In one piece, too. The last Wayfinder was sick on the jetty.
Mara Venn. I'll be showing you around Hearthgrove.

choices.reply: Quieter than it was. Thirty years quieter.
A person of few words. The Signari will like you.

lines.text: You'll hear about the Hush. Every station went silent in one night.
Signari scattered. Villages lost each other. Ask ten people why, you'll get ten answers.
Now the signal's coming back, in pieces. That's why we need you.
Go and see Old Fen at the Workshop. Touch nothing.

steps.goal: See Old Fen at the Workshop

lines.text: Ah! New hands. Don't touch that. Or that.
That one you can touch. It's already broken.
Here. Resonance Compass. I built it myself, so it's probably fine.
You received the Resonance Compass.
It won't tell you where to go. It will tell you when something is listening.

choices.reply: Badly, at first. Then it learns you.
Hmph. Say that when it works.

lines.text: Nobody walks these meadows alone. Mara! Bring the little ones!
These two have been waiting for someone.
Choose the one you'd want beside you on a bad day.

starter.reply: Glintle. Be patient with it. It's braver than it looks.
Driftfin. It will get you wet. You'll forgive it.

lines.text: The meadows are waking up. Find a wild Signari and go gently.
Wear it down, get close, and hold the compass steady. Hold F.
We never take a Signari. We listen until it answers.

steps.goal: Tune in a wild Signari, then tell Mara
steps.notYet: Not yet? Go gently. Wear it down, get close, hold F.

lines.text: It answered you. Do you know how long that took me, my first time?

choices.reply: Yes. Remember that. Most people forget.

lines.text: That field past the well is yours, by the way. Plant something.
A Wayfinder needs somewhere to come back to.
Compass parts rattle. I need moss to pack them. Soft Moss, two handfuls.

steps.notYet: Two handfuls of Soft Moss. It grows along the north lane.

lines.text: Lovely. Damp. Slightly alive. Here, for your trouble.
You received 40 coins.

steps.goal: Someone is waiting in the north lane

lines.text: You're the new one! Juno Hale. Also new. But better.
First one to the top of the Wayfinder list wins. Starting now.

won.text: ...That wasn't luck, was it. Next time, then.

lost.text: Ha! Go and rest. I'll be right here, being better.

steps.goal: Tell Mara what the compass heard

lines.text: The compass shivers in your hand.
Far off in the grove, something is listening. It sounds afraid.

steps.goal: Tell Mara what the compass heard

lines.text: The Singing Root. There's a guardian there, old as the village.
Go carefully. And come back and tell me what you see.
A small iron bell hangs from its bark. It will not stop ringing.

won.text: The bell cracks and falls. Slowly, the shaking stops.
For the first time in a long while, its signal comes through. It stays to guard the grove.

lost.text: You wake by the village. The bell is still ringing, somewhere.

lines.text: A bell? Show me.
...Nobody in Hearthgrove makes bells like this.

choices.reply: Get some rest. We'll talk about Liltwood.
Someone who thinks they're helping. That's the worst kind.

steps.goal: Take the compass to Old Fen

lines.text: Give me that compass. Hm. It's found a second voice. Coming from Liltwood.
There. Now it'll hear further. Mind you, so will they.
End of the region 1 opening. Liltwood comes with region 2.
